name: azure-devops-qa-agent
description: Agent-driven MCP server for Azure DevOps test automation — generates test cases and Gherkin regression scenarios without LLM API calls
author: Gokulnath Kumar

tools.name: fetch_work_item_for_test_generation
tools.description: Fetches Azure DevOps work item data to generate test cases (Step 1 of 2)

tools.name: create_and_link_test_cases
tools.description: Creates test cases in Azure DevOps and links them to work items (Step 2 of 2)

tools.name: fetch_feature_for_gherkin_generation
tools.description: Fetches feature hierarchy and existing test coverage for Gherkin generation (Step 1 of 2)

tools.name: attach_gherkin_regression_to_feature
tools.description: Attaches generated Gherkin feature file to Azure DevOps Feature work item (Step 2 of 2)
